observations: Prediction defines positional palindromic substrings and asks count for aaaa.
Growing second-letter center found two palindromes in both aaaa and abaa.
Growing central gap found aa and aaaa in the first string, but stopped immediately on b/a mismatch in the second; screenshot shows green spans versus red mismatch.
All seven centers found ten versus six palindromes. Only nine of ten abaa substrings were tested because failed ba made whole abaa unnecessary; reveal explains unique centers and two-n-minus-one.
